title: 412 Voices Answered: She Named Us Nothing | ECHO//30 Ep. 7
description:
NULL forces Kavi and Tara to relive the memories they hide—then speaks with the voices of 412 erased commuters. Tara stops Byte's attack long enough to learn what the so-called monster really wants.

But NULL's answer exposes Mira's first exchange: Tara's public identity was the price of Mira's projection. When Byte's hidden protocol fires anyway, the Red Door finally opens wide enough to reveal the city between minutes.
